description: Source code for the BH1750 light sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including functions for reading sensor data via I2C, configuring measurement modes, and initializing sensor instances.

methods.name: bh1750_opcode_read
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit value from the sensor using a specified opcode over I2C.

methods.name: bh1750_opcode_write
methods.description: Writes an opcode to the sensor over I2C.

methods.name: bh1750_mtreg_write
methods.description: Writes the measurement time register value to the sensor.

methods.name: bh1750_get_mode_from_dts_device
methods.description: Determines sensor mode based on device tree configuration.

methods.name: bh1750_get_wait_time_from_dts_device
methods.description: Calculates wait time based on device tree configuration.

methods.name: bh1750_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches a sample measurement from the sensor.

methods.name: bh1750_channel_get
methods.description: Converts raw sensor data to physical light level units.

methods.name: bh1750_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, setting up configuration.
